Heroes face prophecy, divine rivalry, and legendary trials in a world where every deed becomes a story.
Two cities read a reversed river as a promise of victory. Recover the omen's hidden condition and decide whether civic honor can mean a shared rescue.
A homeward crew encounters the voice of a companion it abandoned. Free a captive storm and restore a truthful story before the beacon will lead them home.
A living visitor follows an unfinished request across death's border. Face unequal judgment, choose the cost of a farewell and return without commanding the dead.

Open with the reversed river and two opposed victory claims.

Islands of the Odyssey: Weather without a Master

A three to four hour Islands of the Odyssey game: A homeward crew encounters the voice of a companion it abandoned. Free a captive storm and restore a truthful story before the beacon will lead them home.
Use the missing companion’s bowl, echo and song as three routes to the truth.
State evacuation and diving costs before releasing the captive storm.
Let the crew acknowledge abandonment through a log, song or shared memory.
